Udacity project using the Kaggle Bike Sharing Demand dataset.

Improving a bike-demand prediction baseline

An AutoGluon experiment comparing a first baseline, time features and hyperparameter tuning.

Python · AutoGluon · pandas · Amazon SageMaker

The question

A raw baseline leaves useful time and weather structure unexplored.

The work

  • Train an initial tabular predictor.
  • Engineer calendar and time features and compare distributions.
  • Tune the model and compare the saved competition scores.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Saved test-score chart shows improvement across the initial, feature-engineered and tuned experiments.

What I learned

  • Feature quality and evaluation choices can matter as much as model selection.

Project context

  • Competition experiment; scores are historical notebook outputs.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
